title: On-bead purification and nanodisc reconstitution of human chemokine receptor complexes
author: Gu, Huang, et al.

steps.title: Prepare POPC:POPG lipid stock
steps.instruction: Prepare a 63.7 mg/mL (83.8 mM) POPC:POPG (60:40 w/w) lipid mixture solubilized in 180 mM sodium cholate and store at –80 °C.

substeps.instruction: Solubilize POPC and POPG separately in chloroform at 25 mg/mL; store stocks at –20 °C.
Calculate required volumes; e.g., for 15 mg total lipid mix use 360 µL POPC stock and 240 µL POPG stock.
Add calculated volumes to a glass test tube with a glass syringe and dry under nitrogen until a glossy lipid film forms.
Further dry the film in a desiccator at 25 °C for at least 1 h.
Resuspend the dried film in 180 mM sodium cholate to 63.7 mg/mL (83.8 mM total lipid); aliquot and keep at –80 °C.

steps.title: Prepare MSP1D1 scaffold protein stock
steps.instruction: Solubilize 5 mg lyophilized MSP1D1 in 20 mM HEPES pH 7.5, 150 mM NaCl to 2 mg/mL (100 µM), aliquot 500 µL and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Equilibrate and wash 1D4 resin
steps.instruction: Wash 0.5 mL 1D4 antibody resin slurry (50 % resin) with 5 mL Regular buffer twice; centrifuge 300 × g, 4 °C, 5 min each time and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Bind solubilized receptor to resin
steps.instruction: Add the solubilized receptor to the washed resin, rotate on ice at 4 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Pellet resin and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the receptor‑resin mixture at 300 × g, 4 °C, 5 min; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash resin with regular buffer
steps.instruction: Wash the resin with 20 mL Regular buffer, centrifuge 300 × g, 4 °C, 5 min and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Transfer resin to tubes and final wash
steps.instruction: Divide the resin into two 2 mL Lo‑bind tubes (~250 µL resin each), wash each tube with 1 mL Regular buffer, centrifuge as above and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Add lipid mixture to resin
steps.instruction: Dilute the POPC:POPG stock to 2 mM total lipid with Regular buffer, add 500 µL of this 2 mM lipid mixture to each tube, rotate on ice at 4 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Remove excess lipid supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lipid‑resin mixture 1 min at 300 × g, 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add MSP1D1 to lipid‑resin mixture
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 2 mg/mL MSP1D1 to each tube and rotate on ice at 4 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Detergent removal with Bio‑beads
steps.instruction: Add ~20 mg pre‑washed Bio‑beads SM‑2 to each tube and rotate on ice at 4 °C for 12–16 h.

substeps.instruction: Wash Bio‑beads with methanol, then thoroughly with water according to the manufacturer’s instructions; store the washed beads in water until use.

steps.title: Remove Bio‑beads and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 min at 300 × g, 4 °C and discard the supernatant containing the beads.

steps.title: Wash nanodisc resin with HBS buffer
steps.instruction: Wash each tube three times with 500 µL HBS buffer, centrifuging 1 min at 300 × g, 4 °C each time and discarding the supernatant.

steps.title: Elute nanodisc‑receptor with 1D4 peptide
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 200 µM 1D4 peptide dissolved in HBS to each tube, rotate on ice at 4 °C for 1 h to elute the nanodisc‑solubilized receptor.

steps.title: Collect eluate and repeat elution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge 1 min at 300 × g, 4 °C, collect the supernatant into a 15 mL conical tube; repeat the elution (steps above) two more times and combine all eluates (~3 mL total).

steps.title: Combine eluates and store sample
steps.instruction: Store the combined nanodisc‑receptor preparation at 4 °C (do not freeze); the sample remains stable for at least several days to a week.
